verdict.rationale: Dover documents a public API for adding candidates, fetching jobs and automating recruitment processes, plus a machine-readable spec and an MCP server covering jobs, candidates, applications and interview workflows. Nothing claims or shows parity with the UI: the docs describe many UI-only features with no API coverage. missing for 10: any stated UI-parity commitment, documented API coverage for offers, approvals, permissions, careers page, reporting/analytics, bulk actions, CRM campaigns and settings, independent corroboration of API breadth

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: With the API, you can programmatically add candidates to your jobs, fetch job listings, and automate various recruitment processes.
The full machine-readable specification is available at [app.dover.com/docs/api.json](https://app.dover.com/docs/api.json).
Set up the Dover MCP server to give AI tools access to jobs, candidates, applications, and interview workflows in Dover.
